headline: China's transport ministry sets out 22 AI application scenarios for water transport
summary: China's Ministry of Transport issued a Chinese-language guide identifying 22 priority AI application scenarios for water transport, grouped under safety, efficiency and green transition. The examples span port risk monitoring, vessel and waterway safety, intelligent scheduling, logistics coordination, shipping-cost analysis and carbon management. The document records ministry policy direction, not completed deployment. It provides no funding or deadlines and reports no measured changes in safety, productivity, costs or emissions.
